sentences.japanese: 彼がそれを聞いたら喜ぶよ。
sentences.english: He would be glad to hear that.

sentences.japanese: 君の帰りが早ければ早いほど、お父さんは喜ぶでしょう。
sentences.english: The sooner you return, the happier your father will be.

sentences.japanese: 君のためなら喜んでなんでもする。
sentences.english: I am ready to do anything for you.

sentences.japanese: あなたのためなら喜んでどんなことでもします。
sentences.english: I am ready to do anything for you.

sentences.japanese: 君が賛成してくれれば喜んで彼にその仕事を提供しよう。
sentences.english: With your approval, I would like to offer him the job.
